title: CellarTracker Bottle Daily Event Volume
dataSources: CellarTracker bottles (`cellartracker:bottle`), Vivino wines (`vivino:wine`), spirits bottles (`spirit:bottle`), and wine tasting notes (`wine:tasting`).
app: CellarTracker bottle exports, Vivino wine scans, spirits inventory logs, and tasting note journals forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=cellartracker:bottle
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count as events, dc(region) as distinct_entities by _time
| sort - _time
description: Counts how many CellarTracker bottle events land each day and how many distinct region values are represented.
value: Daily volume is the fastest way to spot a dead feed, a sudden burst, or a workflow that quietly changed.
implementation: Ingest CellarTracker bottle records into `index=personal`; schedule daily and compare count and distinct region values against your normal baseline.
visualization: Column chart of daily event count with a line for distinct entities.
grandmaExplanation: It warns how much CellarTracker bottle activity showed up each day so you can see if the feed went quiet or suddenly got busy.
